thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall — elevated 5xx rate detected for quasar-health in dedicated-vpc pool 'dq-pool-3' (canary slice). Threshold breached: 6.2% errors over 3m. Correlation: pinned artifact rollout 4m ago.

carmen: acked. I'm oncall — grabbing context. tagging evan for SRE lead.

evans: on it. evan here. can you paste the exact error we're seeing? 5xx like model OOM or gateway?

incident-bot: Top error signatures (sample):
```
InferenceError: kv-cache OOM at token 1342
429 TooManyRequests from model-runtime
ModelRuntimeError: invalid response shape
```

ajay: @evan likely kv-cache pressure from the new artifact - changes to kv memory layout in that build. we saw similar in perf test but not at scale.

liam: dev/deploy notes: canary was set to 10% for quasar-health, artifact sha256:abcd1234 deployed 4m ago and pinned on pool. previous pinned artifact was sha256:9f8e7d6c.

marie: customer-eng here — Quasar reported elevated latencies from end users and a few failed requests to their clinical ingestion pipeline. They're seeing errors in patient intake flow. Customer impact: moderate, occurring for ~15% of requests hitting canary.

carmen: triage plan: 1) isolate tenant/quarantine if possible, 2) divert Quasar traffic off canary back to pinned artifact, 3) monitor. If divert fails, we roll the pool back.

evans: Agreed. Carmen, can you isolate quasar-tenant-7 to avoid cross-tenant spill? ajay can help.

ajay: I can take isolation. Will move tenant to quarantine slice. Command: `redwoodctl tenant quarantine --tenant quasar-tenant-7 --pool dq-pool-3`

liam: executing divert now — switching routing for quasar-health to fallback model variant (pinned artifact 9f8e7d6c) using canary routing override.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling routing override for tenant quasar-health: from canary(sha256:abcd1234) -> pinned(sha256:9f8e7d6c). Progress: 0%

ops-bot: telemetry: canary traffic for dq-pool-3 -> quasar-health: 10% -> 2%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Progress: 50%

carmen: @marie please confirm with customer if errors reduce as we shift them off canary. Need quick validation.

marie: on it. pinged Quasar CSM, they are running a quick smoke. Will update in ~2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Progress: 100% — routing override applied. Quasar traffic now routing to pinned artifact sha256:9f8e7d6c.

ops-bot: telemetry: canary traffic for dq-pool-3 -> quasar-health: 2% -> 0% (now)

incident-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate for quasar-health dropped to baseline 0.4% over 2m after routing override.

evans: Nice. Carmen — do we still quarantine the tenant or unquarantine now that traffic is diverted? I prefer keep isolated for 15m to watch for leftover sessions.

carmen: keep quarantine for 15m. ajay can run quick memory probes on canary nodes and we should collect kernel logs / runtime traces.

ajay: collecting logs now. grabbing runtime traces and heap profiles from the canary hosts: dq-canary-1,dq-canary-2. Will upload to infra-bucket.

liam: note for rollback: we should unpin the bad artifact from pool to prevent accidental traffic bounce. I'll also add a pool-level fallback policy to prefer older artifact for this tenant.

marie: Quasar smoke passed — errors gone on their side. They confirm patient intake works again. Thanks.

evans: ok, next steps: 1) keep tenant quarantined 15m, 2) run forensic on artifact abcd1234, 3) unpin from dq-pool-3, 4) create mitigation playbook for mem-layout changes. Carmen — assign owners?

carmen: owners: ajay -> analysis + logs (ETA 4h), liam -> unpin + pool fallback (ETA 20m), evan -> post-incident watch + rollback authority (oncall). marie -> customer comms & post-notify. I'll synthesize a short incident ticket.

ajay: quick findings (prelim): memory allocator change in abcd1234 increases kv-buffer reservation on long-context sessions. reproduces with synthetic trace at ~1.2k tokens -> OOM in 10-15% of runs. attaching repro snippet: 
```
# repro script
python stress_infer.py --model-artifact sha256:abcd1234 --tokens 1400 --batch 1
```
logs uploaded: gs://redwood-incidents/dq/quasar/2149998888/logs.tar.gz

liam: I've unpinned abcd1234 from dq-pool-3 and set pool fallback route to 9f8e7d6c as primary. commands run: 
```
redwoodctl pool unpin --pool dq-pool-3 --artifact sha256:abcd1234
redwoodctl pool set-fallback --pool dq-pool-3 --artifact sha256:9f8e7d6c
```

ops-bot: telemetry: pool dq-pool-3 artifact usage: 9f8e7d6c = 100% for quasar-health; no other tenants impacted.

carmen: good. evan — keep monitoring for 30m then escalate to SEV if other tenants show anomalies. Also schedule short blameless postmortem.

evans: will monitor. setting watch flag and creating incident ticket IR-2149998888.

marie: customer touchpoint: emailed CSM and scheduled a 1:1 with Quasar for details + mitigation notes. they appreciate the quick revert.

ajay: follow-ups: create regression test for kv-buffer layout change, add canary memory burn-in for 30m at 10% traffic, update rollout checklist to include mem-profile check.

liam: ops action: add an automatic unpin hold for 10m after pinning new artifacts for dedicated pools to give telemetry time. I'll open infra PR.

carmen: thanks all. I'll mark this thread as mitigated once quarantine lifted and 30m watch complete. final status to be posted in incident tracker. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident mitigation note appended to IR-2149998888: routing override applied -> pinned artifact restored for quasar-health; tenant quarantined; artifact abcd1234 unpinned from dq-pool-3; logs collected.

carmen: closing loop: quarantine lifted at +18m, no further errors observed. moving to monitoring. will own postmortem.

marie: confirming customer notified and follow-up scheduled.

evans: closing watch in 30m. good job team.
